originals.citation: Gopal, B., & Cooper, S. (2022). POGIL-like Learning in Undergraduate Software Testing and DevOps - A Pilot Study. ITiCSE 2022.

quote: We present in this paper our findings from replicating our previously published study of a process oriented guided inquiry based learning approach called POGIL-like in the topics of unit testing, integration testing and continuous integration ... In our original paper we employed POGIL-like in an in-person classroom.
notes: Self-replication of the in-person pilot. @gopal2022b is their peer-instruction replication, a different study. DOI of the original not verified.
